name: BMGREEN
recent: BM GreenTech 近期持续进行股份回购，并因员工行使凭单而发行新股。董事 Dr Chia Song Kun 在公开市场增持股份。公司于8月20日举行第16届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过，包括派发每股3.00仙的终期股息。
notable: 公司于2026年8月20日举行第16届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。
公司宣布派发截至2026年3月31日财年的终期单层股息每股3.00仙，总额 RM20,633,892。
公司因凭单转换为普通股而发行325股新股，于2026年8月28日上市。
risks: 董事 Dr Chia Song Kun 在2026年10月5日至7日期间于公开市场增持公司股份。
公司近期多次进行股份回购。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为 RM163.964 million，环比下降14.6%，但同比增长28.4%；净利为 RM11.104 million，环比下降43.3%，同比下降14.2%；净利率为6.8%，低于上一季度的10.2%。

recent_en: BM GreenTech has recently been conducting share buybacks and issued new shares from warrant exercises. Director Dr Chia Song Kun acquired shares in the open market. The company held its 16th AGM on 20 August, where all resolutions were passed, including a final dividend of 3.00 sen per share.
notable_en: The company held its 16th AGM on 20 August 2026, and all resolutions were passed.
The company declared a final single-tier dividend of 3.00 sen per share for FY ended 31 March 2026, totaling RM20,633,892.
The company issued 325 new shares from warrant conversion, listed on 28 August 2026.
risks_en: Director Dr Chia Song Kun acquired shares in the open market between 5 and 7 October 2026.
The company has conducted multiple share buybacks recently.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM163.964 million, down 14.6% QoQ but up 28.4% YoY; net income was RM11.104 million, down 43.3% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net margin was 6.8%, lower than 10.2% in the previous quarter.
